knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 2.6.2
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) What is a statistic in this LO? (2) What is its sampling distribution? (3) How does that differ from one realised value from one sample?
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: A statistic is a function of the sample. Its sampling distribution is the distribution of that statistic over repeated random samples. One realised value is a single draw from that distribution, not the distribution itself.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 2.6.2
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. A colleague says 'my sample mean is 12, so the sampling distribution is 12.' Refuse and restate today's LO.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse: a realised statistic is not its sampling distribution. Today's skill is describing the distribution of the statistic over repeated samples.
